changelog:
- Initial release of the huawei-cloud-evs-list skill.
- Lists Huawei Cloud EVS (Elastic Volume Service) disks with key fields: name, id, status, size.
- Supports filtering by status, disk name, and pagination (limit/offset).
- Can output either a detailed disk list or a name-only list.
- Uses hcloud KooCLI (primary) or huaweicloudsdkevs Python SDK (fallback).
- Read-only: does not create, modify, or delete any disks.
summary: Query the list of Huawei Cloud EVS (Elastic Volume Service) disks under the current tenant / project, focused on the EVS disk NAME list. Returns each disk's name, id, status and size; can also output a pure EVS name-only list. Supports filtering by status, name and pagination (limit/offset). Uses the KooCLI command `hcloud EVS ListVolumes --cli-region={region}` (primary) against the v2 API, or the huaweicloudsdkevs Python SDK (fallback). Read-only — never creates, modifies or deletes any disk. Use this skill whenever the user wants to list/inspect the EVS disks of the tenant or query the EVS disk name list, e.g. for disk inventory, daily inspection, or cost review. Triggers include: "list EVS", "EVS list", "query EVS names", "EVS name list", "云硬盘列表", "查询云硬盘", "EVS磁盘名称", "云硬盘名称", "list volumes", "list elastic volumes", "how many EVS disks".
